verifications.claim: The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships take place on Thursday, March 19 to Saturday, March 21, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Thursday, March 19, through Saturday, March 21." (R2); "March 19-21" (R4, R6); "Thursday, March 19 | ... Saturday, March 21" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the exact dates and days for the 2026 event.

verifications.claim: The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships take place at Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse in Cleveland, Ohio.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Rocket Arena this week" in Cleveland context (R1); "Rocket Arena in Cleveland, Ohio" (R2); "Rocket Arena, Cleveland" (R4, R6, R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently refer to 'Rocket Arena' in Cleveland, Ohio, which corresponds to Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse, but do not use the full name, making support indirect.

verifications.claim: The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships feature 330 wrestlers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "With 330 wrestlers hoping for a full three-day stay" (R1); "A total of 330 wrestlers compete at the NCAA Division I Men's Wrestling Championships" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state 330 wrestlers for the championships.

verifications.claim: ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPNU will broadcast sessions of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "broadcast across ESPN, ESPN2 and ESPNU" (R2); "TV: ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU" (R4); "Select sessions will be on ESPN, ESPN2 or ESPNU" (R6); same in R7
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly list ESPN, ESPN2, and ESPNU as broadcasters.

verifications.claim: All matches of the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships, including individual mat feeds, are available on ESPN+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Every match will also be streamed on ESPN+, including concurrent mat coverage" (R2, R7); "All sessions will be streamed on ESPN+" (R6); "Streaming: ESPN+" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: "Concurrent mat coverage" directly supports individual mat feeds; all matches on ESPN+ confirmed.

verifications.claim: The 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships use a double-elimination bracket for 330 participants across 10 weight classes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 330 wrestlers (R1, R5); "10 weight classes" with lists (R2, R5, R7); "double-elimination format" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm 330 participants/wrestlers, 10 weight classes explicitly listed, and double-elimination format.

verifications.claim: The weight classes in the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships are 125, 133, 141, 149, 157, 165, 174, 184, 197, 285.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Lists exactly: "125 lbs...133 lbs...141 lbs...149 lbs...157 lbs...165 lbs...174 lbs...184 lbs...197 lbs...285 lbs" (R2, R7); same 10 classes (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources list the exact 10 weight classes matching the claim.

verifications.claim: Teams score points in the 2026 NCAA Division I Wrestling Championships based on individual wrestler advancements, wins by fall, technical falls, major decisions, and placement on the podium from 1st through 8th place.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Wrestlers also accumulate points for their institution with every win as they advance through the bracket"; "top eight finishers in the double-elimination format will be honored as All-Americans"
verifications.reasoning: Supports points for advancements/wins and top 8 placement broadly, but no specific mention of win types (fall, technical fall, major decision).
